description: This accommodation is very central and perfectly located, offering easy access to all sites and amenities, 12 minutes walk to the Louvre, 3 minutes walk to the metro line 3 Sentier stationThe spaceBeautiful and quiet 75m2 apartment, well-equipped and very central. Has two bedrooms (each bedroom has a double bed with sheets) bathroom with toilet ( has towels, shower gel, toilet paper, hair dryer, iron) a living room with sofa bed and a closed place in living room where there is a 3rd bed as you can see in the photos In the living room you will also find: 2 desks, TV, fibre optic Wi-Fi, dining table with chairs And the kitchen is well equipped with everything you need for a short or long stay (there is no oven)Perfect choice for families or a group of friendsCentrally located in the heart of Paris, which also gives you the opportunity to visit many neighbourhoods on foot, about 10 minutes' walk from: - châtelet - République 8 min- the Beaubourg centre 10 min- Notre-Dame de Paris 15 mins- Marais 10 minutes away - Opera 12 min- Louvre 12 min- Bastille 15 mins- Eiffel Tower 15 minutes by metro Near many museums, theatres, shops, cafes, restaurants and other interesting places, and many metro lines (8, 9, 4, 3) Bonne Nouvelle, Sentier, Strasbourg Saint-Denis stations, and a 10-minute walk to Châtelet - Le Halles RER A, B, D and metro lines 1, 4, 7, 11, 14 This will also give you the opportunity to easily reach the airportsRegistration details7510208654708
